# OnePointer 0.1.0
首个公开版本。
- 双击同一侧 Control，短暂灰屏并聚焦鼠标位置 - 保留圆形、聚光灯、圆环、十字准星和脉冲演示模式 - 保留涟漪、颜色闪光和收缩回弹点击效果 - 支持多显示器、全屏空间和开机启动 - 简体中文与英文界面 - 使用 Sparkle 提供安全的自动更新
---
First public release.
- Double-tap the same Control key to briefly dim every display and focus the pointer - Circle, spotlight, ring, crosshair, and pulse presentation modes - Ripple, color-flash, and shrink-and-bounce click effects - Multiple displays, full-screen Spaces, and launch at login - English and Simplified Chinese interface - Secure automatic updates powered by Sparkle
